title: Sort bottles safely in a crowded vertical rack
instruction: Sort all six bottles between the stacked shelves: red below, blue above. The gray staging pedestal is available. Keep every bottle upright and prevent falls, including neighboring bottles. Finish with both grippers open and withdrawn, with every bottle stable for two seconds.
context: Storage and return logistics often require correcting a mixed arrangement while preserving neighboring containers. Unlike removing one selected bottle to an empty tray, this task requires moving misplaced bottles between two constrained shelf levels and finishing with the whole rack correctly classified and stable.
setup: Fixed bimanual YAM station: two 6-DoF arms with parallel-jaw grippers, bases (0,+/-0.305,0.750) m; fixed wood table 1.10 x 1.30 x 0.060 m, center (0.360,0,0.7175) m, top z=0.7475 m; x forward into the rack, y left, z up. All fixtures are fixed wooden solids. red_shelf: size (0.13, 0.17, 0.012) m, center (0.335, 0, 0.7915) m. blue_shelf: size (0.13, 0.17, 0.012) m, center (0.335, 0, 0.9515) m. rack_roof: size (0.13, 0.17, 0.012) m, center (0.335, 0, 1.1115) m. rack_back: size (0.012, 0.194, 0.32) m, center (0.406, 0, 0.9575) m. rack_side_left: size (0.13, 0.012, 0.37) m, center (0.335, 0.091, 0.9325) m. rack_side_right: size (0.13, 0.012, 0.37) m, center (0.335, -0.091, 0.9325) m. staging_pad: size (0.08, 0.08, 0.16) m, center (0.25, 0.23, 0.8275) m. Six loose upright opaque rigid bottle surrogates, each 100 mm tall, 36 mm maximum diameter, 0.08 kg; compound body/shoulder/neck cylinders. Static/dynamic friction 0.65/0.50, restitution zero. blue_swap: center (0.294, 0.0, 0.8475) m, color blue. red_left: center (0.294, 0.06, 0.8475) m, color red. red_right: center (0.294, -0.06, 0.8475) m, color red. red_swap: center (0.294, 0.0, 1.0075) m, color red. blue_left: center (0.294, 0.06, 1.0075) m, color blue. blue_right: center (0.294, -0.06, 1.0075) m, color blue. Bottles begin 6 mm from the open shelf front; outer bottles have 7 mm side clearance and adjacent bottle surfaces are 24 mm apart. Upper shelf and roof block top-down entry. No pose jitter. Standard station table/floor, robot mounts, ancillary camera-stand colliders, camera poses and lights are enumerated in scene_inventory.json; all are reproduced by the pinned station scene. For physical reproduction use colored plastic bottles with the listed geometry and mass. No glass-fracture behavior is required.
scoring: Score 0 permanently after any bottle tilts more than 20 degrees, moves downward faster than 0.35 m/s, has its bottom below z=0.7915 m, has its center outside x=[0.07,0.44] m or y=[-0.15,0.27] m, or has its top above z=1.1775 m. Missing/nonfinite pose data invalidates the trial. A sorted bottle has its complete bounding box on the matching shelf with at least 3 mm edge clearance, bottom within 4 mm of the surface, and tilt at most 5 degrees. Before any credit, both grippers must be at least 75% open and each TCP at least 85 mm from every bottle center, every bottle must remain at most 5 degrees tilted, and all bottle centers must stay within 3 mm of their positions at the start of a continuous two-second released window. Then score max(0,sorted_count-4)/2: 0 for four or fewer, 0.5 for five, 1.0 for all six. The initial layout scores 0. Vertical-axis spin and contact-force telemetry do not affect score. Use a ruler/protractor and calibrated video as described in PHYSICAL_SCORING.md.
reset_notes: Restore the six listed upright bottle poses, zero velocities, arms to READY, and a fresh safety latch. Fixtures remain fixed. Use seed 0 and zero pose jitter.
fidelity: PhysX rigid-body contact and gravity at 240 Hz, 20 Hz robot control. Real collision geometry for shelves, roof, panels and rigid compound bottle surrogates; no object snapping or attachments. This benchmark measures visible tipping/falling and final placement stability. Opaque rigid bottles do not fracture, and no glass-breakage or force-based damage performance is claimed. Contact force is diagnostic telemetry only. Downward speed is a declared fall proxy measurable from calibrated video. The supplied run.py provides continuous safety latching and a two-second pose-drift window; rotation about the vertical bottle axis is irrelevant. Physical reproduction uses colored plastic bottle surrogates.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0; scripted demo: 1.0. Both recorded under the finalized observable scorer.
